Title: Onycholysis: Why Your Nail Keeps Lifting After Gel Manicures

Description:
If your nail keeps lifting away from the nail bed and turning white after gel manicures, it's called onycholysis — and it usually comes down to three habits: aggressive buffing before the gel goes on, soaking too long in acetone to remove it, and booking sessions back to back with no break.

Once the nail plate lifts, it doesn't reattach on its own — it has to grow out, which can take months. Ask for gentle buffing, have gel filed down instead of soaked and peeled, and leave nails bare for at least two weeks between sets.
